scope: Node-only isolated filesystem and UI event boundary; no live AE

results.name: Dragging selected files never registers unselected siblings or subfolders
Mixed folders and file parents are registered independently and directory scans recurse
Repeated paths, case aliases on Windows and repeated drops do not duplicate libraries or assets
Dragging another selected sibling merges only that file into its parent group
Registrations and file selections survive service restart
Dropped SVG and PNG reuse verified immutable import snapshots
Changed sources cannot import using an old drop snapshot
A missing file reports partial results without hiding other selected files
Unsupported, missing and relative inputs are reported while valid inputs remain usable
Oversized and active SVG files are blocked rather than becoming importable
The settings directory cannot be registered through drag and drop
Empty and excessive batches fail before modifying the registry
Concurrent batches serialize and retain both file selections
Removing a dropped file group preserves source files and other registrations
Malformed persisted selections cannot escape the registered directory
UI extracts native paths synchronously and never guesses a path from a file name
Nested drag enter/leave keeps the highlight until the pointer leaves the panel
A drop captures all file paths, hides the overlay and suppresses browser navigation
Busy/demo state rejects drops and sets the cursor to none
URLs and text cannot navigate the panel or register arbitrary paths
Missing native paths report an actionable error and disposal removes handlers
